features.name: Valid Object
features.description: Validates one object whose scalar properties satisfy every rule.

features.name: Single Failure
features.description: Validates one object and returns its single property failure.

features.name: Multiple Failures
features.description: Validates one object and materializes three independent property failures.

features.name: Nested Object
features.description: Traverses a nested object and reports the complete failing property path.

features.name: Collection
features.description: Traverses three collection elements and reports an indexed failure path.

features.name: Conditional Rule
features.description: Applies a tax ID rule only when the input represents a business.

features.name: Custom Rule
features.description: Applies a custom predicate that accepts only even integer codes.

features.name: Stop On First Failure
features.description: Stops validation after the first failing rule in the declared order.

features.name: Async Validation
features.description: Runs a deterministic asynchronous availability rule through the library async API.
features.reason: With this few rated entrants, the reference is a library's own result, not a result earned against a competitor, so the full 200 points would not reflect a win.

features.name: Prepare Validator
features.description: Creates the complete scalar validator or rule graph without validating an input.
